mechanics.claim: Disguised Neeko can still basic attack while retaining her disguise form.
mechanics.quote: While disguised, '''Neeko''' can use {{tip|basic attacks}} while keeping her form.

mechanics.claim: Casting Q or E breaks the disguise immediately; casting R breaks it only after a delay.
mechanics.quote:
Casting {{ai|Q|Neeko}} or {{ai|E|Neeko}}.
*** Casting {{ai|R|Neeko}} will not break the disguise immediately, but after a delay.

mechanics.claim: While disguised as a minion or monster, basic attack damage type/subtype and other combat attributes (crit behavior, projectile type) are copied from the disguise form, which can change damage output.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Basic attack}} damage type ({{tip|basic damage}}, {{tip|ability damage}}), and subtype ({{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}}, {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}})

mechanics.claim: While disguised as a non-champion, Neeko's total attack speed is set to that of the disguise's form, or to 2.0 if the disguise's total attack speed is higher.
mechanics.quote: '''Neeko''' instead has her {{as|'''total''' attack speed}} set to that of the disguise's form, or to {{fd|2.0}} if the disguise's form's {{as|'''total''' attack speed}} is any higher.

mechanics.claim: Taking damage lethal to the disguise's form or a turret's damage breaks the disguise, putting it on a 2-second cooldown; this is separate from the damage itself.
Both Neeko and the disguise's apparent form take damage based on her real current health, armor, and magic resistance, not the disguise's.
mechanics.quote: Both '''Neeko''' and the disguise's form take damage based on her real '''current''' {{as|{{sti|health}}}}, {{as|{{sti|armor}}}}, and {{as|{{sti|magic resistance}}}}.
